frozen.reason: Bank-blind model evaluation after manual actual-library calibration. Includes independent rejected-domain checks for hidden getters/coercion and exact namespace integration. No grading program or bank entry in proposal context.

scope.description: Finite acyclic arrays (including holes), primitives and ordinary React element/portal data with scalar keys. Elements and fragments are leaves; their children are not traversed. Empty top-level input skips traversal, nested empty nodes are normalized to null. Observe count or exact forEach callback argument/index/receiver, return identity and throws. Iterator/thenable/lazy protocols, library-read getters, nonprimitive key coercion, symbol keys, owner Fiber graphs and input mutations require separate evidence. Unaccessed element warning descriptors remain opaque.

proposal.reason: Repair: top-level null and undefined return as-is with no callback. Otherwise recurse over array-like domain objects identified by own numeric length, normalize undefined/boolean/null leaves to null, treat primitive string/number/bigint and React element/portal objects (by $$typeof symbols) as leaves, invoke the supplied callback with receiver forEachContext and arguments [child, count], incrementing count after each invocation, and return undefined from the export.

proposal.reason: Cannot reliably repair within the provided language. The implementation distinguishes real arrays via Array.isArray(children) from other objects, and the previous proposal incorrectly treated any object with an own numeric length as traversable. In this DSL there is no operation that can soundly recognize Array.isArray or otherwise separate arrays from ordinary objects/functions with similar own properties, while the requested boundary domain explicitly includes finite acyclic arrays. Without that host fact, any proposed program would either miss supported arrays or wrongly traverse unsupported non-array objects.
